page_title: How to integrate MailChimp in a JavaScript web app

summary.title: How to integrate MailChimp in a JavaScript web app
summary.one_liner: You learn to build a newsletter subscribe form in a React/Next.js app that posts the email through an Express route to the Mailchimp API.
keywords: how to add newsletter signup to website
takeaways: Build a Subscribe page with a Material-UI form that reads the email via a ref and handles submit with async/await.
Send the email from the browser to an internal API endpoint using a reusable fetch-based sendRequest helper.
Create an Express POST route that parses JSON bodies with body-parser and validates the email.
Forward the email from the server to Mailchimp's API with the request package, then test the flow with Postman.
summary.summary: The tutorial walks through adding a Mailchimp newsletter subscription to a boilerplate app built with React, Material-UI, Next.js, Express, Mongoose and MongoDB. It builds a Subscribe page with a form, a client-side subscribeToNewsletter() method using isomorphic-fetch, and an Express route at /api/v1/public/subscribe that parses the body with body-parser. The final section starts a server-to-server subscribe() method using the request package to POST to Mailchimp; the page as captured ends before the Mailchimp endpoint and Authorization details are filled in. Code examples are shown at each step and the author suggests testing the route with Postman.
